happy.text: Happiness is a direction, not a place.
happy.author: Sydney J. Harris

happy.text: The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
happy.author: Dalai Lama

happy.text: Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
happy.author: Dalai Lama

happy.text: The happiest people don't have the best of everything, they just make the best of everything.
happy.author: Unknown

happy.text: Happiness is when what you think, what you say, and what you do are in harmony.
happy.author: Mahatma Gandhi

sad.text: Tears come from the heart and not from the brain.
sad.author: Leonardo da Vinci

sad.text: The way sadness works is one of the strange riddles of the world.
sad.author: Lemony Snicket

sad.text: Every man has his secret sorrows which the world knows not.
sad.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

sad.text: The good times of today are the sad thoughts of tomorrow.
sad.author: Bob Marley

sad.text: Sadness flies away on the wings of time.
sad.author: Jean de La Fontaine

stressed.text: Don't stress. Do your best. Forget the rest.
stressed.author: Unknown

stressed.text: Stress is caused by being 'here' but wanting to be 'there'.
stressed.author: Eckhart Tolle

stressed.text: Take time to make your soul happy.
stressed.author: Unknown

stressed.text: You have been assigned this mountain to show others it can be moved.
stressed.author: Mel Robbins

stressed.text: Sometimes the most productive thing you can do is relax.
stressed.author: Mark Black

excited.text: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
excited.author: Walt Disney

excited.text: Push yourself, because no one else is going to do it for you.
excited.author: Unknown

excited.text: Great things never come from comfort zones.
excited.author: Unknown

excited.text: Dream it. Wish it. Do it.
excited.author: Unknown

calm.text: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
calm.author: Buddha

calm.text: Calm mind brings inner strength and self-confidence.
calm.author: Dalai Lama

calm.text: In the midst of movement and chaos, keep stillness inside of you.
calm.author: Deepak Chopra

calm.text: Nothing can bring you peace but yourself.
calm.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

calm.text: The quieter you become, the more able you are to hear.
calm.author: Rumi

anxious.text: You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
anxious.author: A.A. Milne

anxious.text: Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom.
anxious.author: Søren Kierkegaard

anxious.text: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
anxious.author: Marcus Aurelius

anxious.text: Worrying does not take away tomorrow's troubles, it takes away today's peace.
anxious.author: Unknown

anxious.text: The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
anxious.author: Joseph Campbell

angry.text: Holding on to anger is like grasping a hot coal with the intent of throwing it at someone else; you are the one who gets burned.
angry.author: Buddha

angry.text: For every minute you remain angry, you give up sixty seconds of peace of mind.
angry.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

angry.text: Anger is an acid that can do more harm to the vessel in which it is stored than to anything on which it is poured.
angry.author: Mark Twain

angry.text: The best fighter is never angry.
angry.author: Lao Tzu

angry.text: Speak when you are angry and you will make the best speech you will ever regret.
angry.author: Ambrose Bierce

romantic.text: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
romantic.author: Lao Tzu

romantic.text: Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
romantic.author: Aristotle

romantic.text: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
romantic.author: Audrey Hepburn

romantic.text: Love is not about how many days, months, or years you have been together. Love is about how much you love each other every single day.
romantic.author: Unknown

romantic.text: In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours. In all the world, there is no love for you like mine.
romantic.author: Maya Angelou

energetic.text: Energy and persistence conquer all things.
energetic.author: Benjamin Franklin

energetic.text: The energy of the mind is the essence of life.
energetic.author: Aristotle

energetic.text: Don't wait for opportunity. Create it.
energetic.author: Unknown

energetic.text: Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
energetic.author: Winston Churchill

energetic.text: The only impossible journey is the one you never begin.
energetic.author: Tony Robbins

melancholic.text: The word 'happiness' would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
melancholic.author: Carl Jung

melancholic.text: There is a sacredness in tears. They are not the mark of weakness, but of power.
melancholic.author: Washington Irving

melancholic.text: The deeper that sorrow carves into your being, the more joy you can contain.
melancholic.author: Kahlil Gibran

melancholic.text: Sometimes you need to sit lonely on the floor in a quiet room in order to hear your own voice and not let it drown in the noise of others.
melancholic.author: Charlotte Eriksson

melancholic.text: The most beautiful people I've known are those who have known trials, have known struggles, have known loss, and have found their way out of the depths.
melancholic.author: Elisabeth Kübler-Ross
